description: A category of the business rules catalog. vcita manages the catalog. The catalog is a tree: a top-level category has no parent, and a sub-category has the code of its top-level category in `parent_code`. The code is unique. A category is available for a business when the business has every feature flag in `required_feature_flags` and every app in `required_apps`, and its parent is available. An API response holds only the available categories.

uid.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the category (e.g., "a357419e-93f4-4ce2-abc4-0e0c12e945c5").

code.description: The unique category code (e.g., "ai_receptionist", "lead_handling"). Rules carry the code of a sub-category as `category_code`.

parent_code.description: The code of the top-level category of a sub-category, or null for a top-level category (e.g., "ai_receptionist" or null).

default_load_mode.description:
The own default load mode of the category, or null to take the default load mode of its parent (e.g., "always", "search" or null).

* `always` - Agents load the rules with the list.
* `search` - Agents find the rules through search only.

effective_default_load_mode.description: The default load mode that applies to the rules of the category: its own, else the one of its parent, else `always` (e.g., "always", "search").

label_key.description: The translation key of the category name (e.g., "bizai.rules_knowledge.topics.ai_receptionist.name", "bizai.rules_knowledge.groups.knowledge_and_files.faq.name").

description.description: The translation key of the category description (e.g., "bizai.rules_knowledge.groups.knowledge_and_files.faq.description" or null).

sort_order.description: The display order of the category among its siblings (e.g., 20, 140). Lower values come first.

required_feature_flags.description: The feature flags that a business must have to see the category, or null for none (e.g., ["pkg.ai.client_agent"] or null).

required_apps.description: The app code names that a business must have installed to see the category, or null for none (e.g., ["aireceptionist"] or null).

created_at.description: When the category was created, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2026-11-09T00:00:00.000Z").

updated_at.description: When the category was last updated, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2026-11-09T00:00:00.000Z").

children.description: The available sub-categories of the category in `sort_order`. Empty for a sub-category.
